summary: Build practical construction HSE skills with ISO 45001, risk assessment, incident response, and environmental controls. Enrol today.
lede: Construction health, safety and environmental management covers practical ways to control hazards and environmental impacts on active sites. It is designed for site supervisors, HSE officers, construction managers and project engineers who need to plan and document site controls. Participants practice construction risk assessment, incident investigation and site HSE monitoring, including corrective action tracking.
audienceIntro: This course is built for people who work around active construction operations and need to manage safety, health, and environmental controls with credible evidence. It also suits adjacent roles that influence site planning, contractor governance, and executive reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring an understanding of construction activities, site hazards, and basic HSE documentation. A laptop is recommended for workshop exercises, template completion, and dashboard practice, and if available you may bring sample risk assessments, inspection forms, or incident logs from your workplace.
